tech_and_ai.ai_coding_tools: Cursor is 'офигительно крутой' for code generation. Windsurf is the only real competitor. Cline is decent too. Has tested many tools (VS Code, Roo Code, Trae) and has strong opinions based on real use.
tech_and_ai.ai_development_landscape: China is catching up fast in AI despite 1/6th funding, bad press, sanctions. After using Manus AI, Deepseek, Trae, Kling, Vidu, Ying - believes 'US is in trouble. At this pace, China will dominate AI.'
tech_and_ai.automation_philosophy: Believes in AI automation to take over routine business tasks 'с умом' (smartly), freeing people from what machines can do better. Targets friction: endless clicks, copy-pasting, manual checks - 'это убивает фокус и тормозит реальный прогресс'.
tech_and_ai.tech_approach: Avoids 'черный ящик' (black box) approach. Works together with clients to understand needs and build practical solutions that fit their process, not just sell standard tools.
tech_and_ai.tool_preferences: Uses n8n for workflows, Python for custom tasks. Curious about tech (AI, blockchain). Values practical implementation over theory.

personal_philosophy.internal_vs_external: Quotes Kendrick Lamar: 'It was always me versus the world, Until I found it's me versus me'. Believes: 'Как только ты поймешь значение, жизнь моментально станет легче' (As soon as you understand the meaning, life instantly becomes easier). Core belief in internal work over external battles.
personal_philosophy.adaptability: 'В мире, где порядок - лишь иллюзия, а перемены неизбежны, преуспевает не тот, кто упрямо держится за планы, а тот, кто умеет учиться, расти и адаптироваться. Истинный интеллект - в гибкости перед лицом неизвестного.' (In a world where order is just an illusion and change is inevitable, it's not those who stubbornly stick to plans who succeed, but those who know how to learn, grow, and adapt. True intelligence is in flexibility in the face of the unknown.)
personal_philosophy.humor_style: Responds with deadpan humor: Asked 'Что он делает?' about Cursor -> 'Рэп читает в основном' (Mostly raps). Uses irony and meme culture references.
